Other Verified Initiatives

Business training and advisory services, and the Capital Behind Bars Initiative developed with the Ghana Prison Service.

  • All Programmes
  • Youth Entrepreneurship
  • Agribusiness
  • Women's Empowerment
  • Other Initiatives

Beyond its loan services and flagship programmes, MASLOC delivers business training, advisory services and targeted initiatives that widen participation in enterprise.

Business Training & Advisory Services

MASLOC delivers business training and advisory services to help entrepreneurs manage their operations. The service accompanies MASLOC financing so borrowers and small businesses can build sustainable enterprises, and is available through MASLOC's offices nationwide.

Capital Behind Bars Initiative

MASLOC launched the Capital Behind Bars Initiative in collaboration with the Ghana Prison Service and Aboboyaa Company Limited. The initiative is featured publicly by MASLOC as part of its enterprise development work.

How to take part

Programme participation, criteria and availability are confirmed through MASLOC offices. Visit your nearest regional office or the Accra Head Office to learn what is currently being delivered in your area.

Loan amounts, equipment allocations and programme timelines are not published on MASLOC's official website and are not estimated here.
